blog_posts.title: Descaling Heat Exchangers Without Aggressive Acid
blog_posts.body:
## The efficiency tax of scale

Even a thin scale layer drops heat-transfer efficiency and raises energy cost.

## A lower-hazard descale

VertKleen descaling chemistry targets carbonate and mineral scale while holding a lower HMIS profile than conventional acid blends.

> Ask for a dilution guide before your next CIP cycle.

blog_posts.title: What HMIS 0-0-0 Actually Means for Your Facility
blog_posts.body:
## The three numbers

HMIS rates **Health**, **Flammability**, and **Physical hazard** from 0 to 4. A `0-0-0` product scores the lowest on all three.

## Why it matters

Lower ratings can reduce PPE requirements, simplify storage, and ease shipping classification.

- Fewer segregation rules
- Simpler SDS routing
- Lower handling training burden

See our [products](/products) for the full VertKleen line.
blog_posts.author: MASEST Technical Team
blog_posts.excerpt: A 0-0-0 HMIS rating changes how a chemical is stored, shipped, and handled. Here is what the three zeros mean and why they lower your handling burden.
